The '''Pzandias training facility''' was a military base that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pzandias/Legends|Pzandias]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the base was used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] as a training facility.
